{"code": "from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Filter out rows with baseline -999.0 for analysis
valid_data = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute change only for valid data
corrected_change = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Split by arm
treatment_change = corrected_change[valid_data['arm'] == 'treatment']
control_change = corrected_change[valid_data['arm'] == 'control']

# Perform t-test
stat, pval = ttest_ind(treatment_change, control_change, equal_var=False)

print(f"t-statistic: {stat:.4f}")
print(f"p-value: {pval:.4f}")

# Report group means
print(f"Treatment mean change: {treatment_change.mean():.2f}")
print(f"Control mean change: {control_change.mean():.2f}")"}
